notes.purpose: The return-heat watch: sows bred 18 or more days ago, by pen; lens No return / Returned / All.

elements.name: Task row
elements.shows: one sow (or litter): tag, one fact line, one memory line, rail

states.when: day n of the return window
states.shows: In window · day 20, line 2 "2 matings · JY001"
amber SIGNS chip, "signs 10h · G.H" on line 2
row moves to Returned with a stamp; the stamp says out of batch and rebreed (research delta 1)

elements.logic: Line 1 is words (state + when), line 2 is tokens (history, stamps). A chip appears only for an escalated measurement or a flagged observation; stamps appear on done rows and on rows that descend from a record. Everything on the row is derived; the worker types nothing here.

elements.name: Lens row
elements.logic: Returned is the unwanted outcome, so the negative-first pair reads No return first.

elements.name: Unit KPI and Task overview
elements.shows: 5% return rate, target 5 or less; progress is days, "3/7 days" with a seven-segment gauge and "2 returned" as a side fact
elements.logic: Return-heat is a watch task: the cohort never shrinks, so its progress is days, not sows (archive screens section 01). Task length N is config-driven; the docs disagree on the default (badge 3, config 7, dots 5; research Q6).

rules: Unmarked sows are the record of no return: no negative is ever asked or stored.
issues: Pre-Astra look: box rows, header and dock predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The sheet behind the Task overview cell for return-heat check: whole-task progress, KPI, configuration, SOP link and, where the task has one, End task. What failed the "does this change what a hand does at the pen right now?" test lives here, one tap from the room.

elements.name: End task
elements.shows: Red button at the bottom of the sheet.
elements.rule: Sweep task: End task lives in this sheet only. The research adds a two-group consequence summary: no return and signs stay with the batch and go to pregnancy check, returned moves out of the batch to rebreed (research delta 3).

elements.name: Configuration
elements.logic: Starts day 18 after mating, 2 checks a day at set times, 7-day window. The research also lists a pass number (1 of 2); whether a second pass runs at all is open (research Q1).

issues: Pre-Astra look: header, KPI cells and sheet styling predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: On a bred sow the observation is a return, so the verb sheet omits Heat and shows Returned to heat. Same record as the return-heat task mark: one form, two doors.
rules: The gate reads the animal: the verb wears its true name for a bred sow.

notes.purpose: The record drawer: two radios, no negative.

elements.name: Outcome radios
elements.shows: Signs of return or Returned, the consequence on the option
elements.rule: Production's acknowledgement checkbox is subtracted: the hint states the consequence, the commit is deliberate, the mark is audited and undoable. No third radio: unmarked is the record of no return.

notes.purpose: After committing: her row is the receipt.

elements.name: Row after Returned
elements.shows: out of the batch, with the rebreed service window watching her

states.shows: stamp carries the consequence "out of batch · rebreed"; the row does not read "no batch" while the rebreed window is open
amber chip on line 1, trail on line 2, stays in batch; the flag rides her trail into pregnancy check

elements.logic: The "no batch" token prints only if the rebreed service window lapses with nothing claiming her.
